summary: Composite a layer asset over the project timeline: add the layer as a new clip on a target track with opacity and transform (x, y, scale, rotation), producing a new project revision. Native fidelity of the transform subset is declared per adapter, never silent.

inputs.name: layer
inputs.constraints: content-addressed layer asset with probe metadata (durationSeconds, fps, width, height)

outputs.name: updatedProject
outputs.constraints: new immutable project revision with the layer track

parameters.name: layerArtifactRef
parameters.description: Artifact id of the layer asset (content-addressed).

parameters.name: trackIndex
parameters.description: Target video track index (0 = V1 base); missing tracks are created.

parameters.name: transform
parameters.description: Optional tx,ty,scale,rotation tuple (pixels, pixels, ratio, degrees).

qualityDimensions.description: Visual correctness of the composite (blend, transform) against the declared subset.
Which of x/y/scale/rotation survive into the native format unchanged.

costModel.notes: Composite itself is a project operation; cost is realized at render time.

providerMappings.notes: Multi-track tractor + composite transition (a/b track indices). Live conformance skipped in Phase 1 sandbox (melt absent).
VSE channels with ALPHAOVER blend. Live conformance skipped (blender absent).
Read/Merge/Write node graph via NatronRenderer Python script; plugin ids per Natron 2.x declared contract — unverified against a live binary in the Phase 1 sandbox.

filter_complex overlay + colorchannelmixer chain; x/y/scale supported, rotation approximated (declared lossy in adapter fidelity notes). Structural conformance only in sandbox; render-level conformance pending.
